project.title: Microbial communities in wastewater, sewer sediment, and sewer biofilm
project.description: An objective of this study was to characterize the microbial community in sewer deposits compared to wastewater conveyed by the sewer system. This research has implications for understanding the public health risk associated with sewer collection systems. The sampling coordinates were not provided to keep our utility collaborators anonymous.
